name: white keys of a piano. It taps only on the white strands of the web, refusing to touch any black ones, demonstrating the specific set of notes allowed.
'The key of C Major means you're using the notes from the C Major scale for that piece of music.'
A scale is a specific group of notes used to create music, like a color palette.

A Cat pounces on the loose notes the Bird of Paradise kicked up. The Cat arranges these notes into a neat pile, like a painter organizing tubes of paint. It dips its paw into the pile and splashes sound onto the street, showing how the group of notes creates the picture.
